name: iconix_domain_model
description: Build or refine the ICONIX domain model (classes, generalization, aggregation, no operations) in the open Papyrus model.

arguments.name: source
arguments.description: Where the requirements come from (doc path, pasted text, or 'ask me').

name: iconix_use_cases
description: Identify actors and verb-noun use cases, group them in packages (epics), associate them with actors, draw use case diagrams.

arguments.name: scope
arguments.description: Which part of the system to cover (default: everything).

name: iconix_narratives
description: Write basic and alternate courses for use cases and store them as comments on the use cases.

arguments.name: use_cases
arguments.description: Comma-separated use case names (default: all without a narrative).

name: iconix_robustness
description: Robustness analysis (Boundary/Control/Entity) for one use case: package, objects, links, diagram, rule check, domain update.

arguments.name: use_case
arguments.description: Name or id of the use case.

name: iconix_sequence
description: Design the sequence for one use case and allocate behavior (controls) to operations on classes.

arguments.name: use_case
arguments.description: Name or id of the use case.

name: iconix_review
description: Run an ICONIX milestone review: requirements, preliminary (after robustness) or critical (after sequence).

name: agile_backlog_from_usecases
description: Turn the use case model into an agile backlog: epics = use case packages, stories = use cases/alternates, acceptance criteria from narratives.

arguments.name: output
arguments.description: Where to write the backlog (default: Markdown in chat).

name: sprint_plan
description: Propose the next sprint: stories by value/risk/dependencies within capacity, plus the ICONIX work each still needs.
